title: Portuguese Tomato Gratins
description: A simple yet elegant Portuguese-inspired dish featuring fresh tomatoes and creamy cheese, perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.notes: any variety, but cherry tomatoes work well too

ingredients.name: gruyère cheese
ingredients.notes: can be substituted with other Swiss-style cheese

instructions: Slice the bread into 1-inch (2.5 cm) thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Arrange the toasted bread slices in a baking dish. Top each slice with a tomato half, a sprinkle of cheese, and a spoonful of the garlic butter.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve warm.
